# btrfs-disk 0.13.0

This copy of the crates.io release uses checked-in bindings for the packed
Linux Btrfs disk structures. DiskStudio builds for x86-64 Windows without a
local Clang installation. Upstream source and licence notices are included.

The checked-in file was generated by bindgen 0.72.1 and LLVM 18.1.1 from the
included headers, using x86-64 Windows GNU C layout, the portable
`src/raw/linux/types.h` and w64devkit system headers. The header allowlist
recognized both Windows and Unix path separators. The generated assertions
verify the packed layout in the Rust build.
